final: WITH order_counts AS (SELECT account_id, COUNT(*) as order_count FROM `order` GROUP BY account_id), first_avg_val AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(order_count AS REAL)) as val FROM order_counts), above_first AS (SELECT oc.account_id, oc.order_count FROM order_counts oc CROSS JOIN first_avg_val fa WHERE oc.order_count > fa.val), second_avg_val AS (SELECT AVG(CAST(order_count AS REAL)) as val FROM above_first) SELECT afa.account_id, afa.order_count, ROUND(afa.order_count - fa.val, 2) as diff_from_first, ROUND(afa.order_count - sa.val, 2) as diff_from_second FROM above_first afa CROSS JOIN first_avg_val fa CROSS JOIN second_avg_val sa ORDER BY diff_from_second DESC NULLS LAST LIMIT 10
